refined_descriptions.sql-explainer: Explains what an existing SQL query does, step by step, in plain language, covering clauses, joins, subqueries, CTEs, aggregations, and window functions. Unlike cron-scheduler, which generates and validates cron expressions from plain-language schedules, this skill produces no syntax and validates nothing; it only interprets SQL supplied by the user. It does not write, edit, optimize, debug, or execute SQL, does not explain cron expressions or other query languages, and does not assess query performance or recommend schema changes.
refined_descriptions.pdf-signature-check: Inspects PDF documents for embedded digital signatures and verifies each signature's cryptographic validity and document integrity after signing. Unlike cron-scheduler, which generates and validates time-based cron expressions from plain-language schedules, this skill processes PDF files only and performs no scheduling or timestamp work. Does not sign, create, add, remove, or modify signatures; does not validate certificates against external authorities; does not convert, merge, edit, or extract PDF content; does not handle cron expressions or schedule parsing.
refined_descriptions.email-drafter: Drafts reply text for customer emails, applying the support tone guide to produce drafts for human review before sending. Unlike git-bisector, which runs git bisect to locate the commit that introduced a bug, this skill performs text composition only and includes no version-control or debugging functionality. Does not send or fetch emails, triage inboxes, handle non-customer correspondence, edit the tone guide, or inspect commit history.
refined_descriptions.csv-merger: Merges multiple CSV files into one combined output by matching rows on a shared key column; supports configurable key selection and combining columns from inputs. Differs from csv-cleaner, which only repairs formatting, quoting, whitespace, and column names within a single file and never combines or joins data. Does not clean, reformat, or validate individual files, and does not deduplicate rows, split files apart, perform fuzzy or multi-key joins, or convert file formats.
refined_descriptions.git-conflict-resolver: Explains git merge conflicts and suggests a resolution for each hunk: reads conflict markers in working-tree files, identifies the conflicting branches and change intent, and proposes concrete edits. Unlike cron-scheduler, which turns plain-language schedules into validated cron expressions, this skill handles version-control conflict analysis only and has no scheduling capability. It does not run or complete merges or rebases, resolve cherry-pick or stash conflicts, rewrite history, or produce cron expressions; the user applies and commits the suggested resolutions.
refined_descriptions.log-anomaly: Detects unusual patterns, volume spikes, and suspicious lines in structured log records, returning each flagged entry with a reason. Requires pre-parsed logs as input; unlike log-parser, it does not process raw log text or build structured records. Excluded work: parsing raw server logs, extracting timestamps or levels, log collection and ingestion, and alerting or incident response.
refined_descriptions.api-diff: Compares two OpenAPI specifications and reports breaking changes affecting API clients, such as removed operations, changed parameters, altered response schemas, or newly required fields. Unlike email-triage, which classifies inbound support email by intent, urgency, and language, this skill performs structural diffing of API spec files and involves no message classification. Excluded: email or ticket triage, changelog or release-note writing, spec linting or validation, client SDK generation, and testing live endpoints. Input is two spec versions; output is a structured breaking-change report.
refined_descriptions.regex-explainer: Explains an existing regular expression token by token in plain language, covering literals, character classes, quantifiers, groups, anchors, and lookarounds. Unlike regex-builder, which constructs a new pattern from a plain-language description and test strings, this skill accepts a completed pattern as input and outputs an explanation of it. It does not build, generate, write, test, validate, or fix regular expressions, and does not check whether a pattern matches given strings.
refined_descriptions.cron-explainer: Decodes cron expressions into a plain-language explanation of when jobs run, covering all five standard fields plus ranges, steps, lists, and quirks such as day-of-month/day-of-week OR behavior. refined_descriptions.doc-translator: Translates documents between languages while preserving formatting and consistent terminology. refined_descriptions.image-captioner: Generates alt-text captions for image files (PNG, JPEG, WEBP) using a vision model; input is an image, output is a short descriptive caption string.
